summary: Frontend-only E2E validation of Mithila.Foods marketing site. Consider mirroring testids for parity when tests need to run on mobile viewport.

Nav smooth-scroll (Lenis) works. 0 console errors. Mobile nav-menu-toggle opens overlay menu.
